1.65.m: which has the hue of a bandhūka flower, accompanied by his Śakti, who moves in the breath, / whose hands shine with a noose, a goad, a vessel of nectar, and a sweetmeat,

1.65.s:
ṣaṭśataṃ tu gaṇeśāya vāgadhīśāya cārpayet /
svādhiṣṭāne vidrumābhe vādilāntārṇasaṃyute //
1.65.d:
षट्शतं तु गणेशाय वागधीशाय चार्पयेत् ।
स्वाधिष्टाने विद्रुमाभे वादिलान्तार्णसंयुते ॥
1.65.m: one should dedicate six hundred [breaths] to Gaṇeśa, the lord of speech. / In the svādhiṣṭhāna resembling coral, joined with the syllables from 'ba' to 'la',

1.65.s:
vāmāṅgaśaktiyuktāya vidyādhipataye tathā /
sruvākṣamālālasitabāhave padmajanmane //
1.65.d:
वामाङ्गशक्तियुक्ताय विद्याधिपतये तथा ।
स्रुवाक्षमालालसितबाहवे पद्मजन्मने ॥
1.65.m: to the lord of knowledge joined with the Śakti on his left side, / whose arms shine with the ladle and the rosary, to the lotus-born

1.65.s:
brahmaṇe ṣaṭsahasraṃ tu haṃsārūḍhāya cārpayet /
vidyullasitameghābhe ḍādiphaāntārṇapatrake //
1.65.d:
ब्रह्मणे षट्सहस्रं तु हंसारूढाय चार्पयेत् ।
विद्युल्लसितमेघाभे डादिफआन्तार्णपत्रके ॥
1.65.m: Brahmā mounted on a swan, one should dedicate six thousand. / In the [maṇipūra] whose petals have the letters from 'ḍa' to 'pha', resembling a cloud flashed with lightning,

1.65.s:
maṇipūre śaṅkhacakragadāpaṅkadhāriṇe /
saśriye ṣaṭsahasraṃ ca viṣṇave vinivedayet //
1.65.d:
मणिपूरे शङ्खचक्रगदापङ्कधारिणे ।
सश्रिये षट्सहस्रं च विष्णवे विनिवेदयेत् ॥
1.65.m: one should dedicate six thousand to Viṣṇu in the maṇipūra, / who holds the conch, discus, mace, and lotus, together with Śrī.

1.65.s:
anāhater'kapatre ca kādiṭhāntārṇasaṃyute /
śukle śūlābhayavarasadhākalaśadhāriṇe //
1.65.d:
अनाहतेर्ऽकपत्रे च कादिठान्तार्णसंयुते ।
शुक्ले शूलाभयवरसधाकलशधारिणे ॥
1.65.m: In the white twelve-petaled anāhata endowed with the syllables from 'ka' to 'ṭha', / to him who holds a trident, the gestures of fearlessness and boon-granting, and a nectar-pot,

1.65.s:
vāmāṅge śaktiyuktāya vidyādhipataye sudhīḥ /
vṛṣārūḍhāya rudrāya ṣaṭsahasraṃ nivedayet //
1.65.d:
वामाङ्गे शक्तियुक्ताय विद्याधिपतये सुधीः ।
वृषारूढाय रुद्राय षट्सहस्रं निवेदयेत् ॥
1.65.m: to Rudra, the lord of knowledge, mounted on a bull, / accompanied by Śakti on his left side, the wise person should dedicate six thousand.

1.65.s:
viśudde ṣoḍaśadale svarāḍhye śuknatraṇake /
mahājyotiprakāśāyendriyādhipataye tataḥ //
1.65.d:
विशुद्दे षोडशदले स्वराढ्ये शुक्नत्रणके ।
महाज्योतिप्रकाशायेन्द्रियाधिपतये ततः ॥
1.65.m: In the sixteen-petaled viśuddha, rich in vowels, having white filaments, / to the lord of the senses, possessing the brilliance of a great light,

1.65.s:
sahasramarpayetprāṇaśaktyā yukteścarāya ca /
ājñācakre hakṣayukte dvidile 'bje sahasrakam //
1.65.d:
सहस्रमर्पयेत्प्राणशक्त्या युक्तेश्चराय च ।
आज्ञाचक्रे हक्षयुक्ते द्विदिले ऽब्जे सहस्रकम् ॥
1.65.m: to Īśvara united with the vital breath-energy, one should offer one thousand. / In the two-petaled lotus of the ājñā-cakra endowed with 'ha' and 'kṣa', one should offer one thousand

1.65.s:
sadāśivāya gurave parāśaktiyutāya vai /
sahasrāre mahāpadme nādabindudvayānvite //
1.65.d:
सदाशिवाय गुरवे पराशक्तियुताय वै ।
सहस्रारे महापद्मे नादबिन्दुद्वयान्विते ॥
1.65.m: to Sadāśiva, the guru, who is indeed united with the supreme energy. / In the great thousand-petaled sahasrāra, endowed with both nāda and bindu,

1.65.s:
vilasanmātṛkāvarṇe varāmayakarāya ca /
praramādye ca gurave sahasraṃ vinivedayet //
1.65.d:
विलसन्मातृकावर्णे वरामयकराय च ।
प्ररमाद्ये च गुरवे सहस्रं विनिवेदयेत् ॥
1.65.m: shining with the letters of the alphabet, granting boons and fearlessness with his hands, / one should dedicate one thousand to the supreme primordial guru.

1.65.s:
culukeṃ'bu punarddhṛtvā svabhāvādeva sidhyataḥ /
ekaviṃśatisāhasrapramitasya japasya ca //
1.65.d:
चुलुकेंऽबु पुनर्द्धृत्वा स्वभावादेव सिध्यतः ।
एकविंशतिसाहस्रप्रमितस्य जपस्य च ॥
1.65.m: Then, holding water in the cupped hand, [one offers the fruit] of the recitation / accomplished naturally, measuring twenty-one thousand

1.65.s:
ṣaṭśatādhikasaṃkhyāsyā dajapāyā vibhāgaśaḥ /
saṃkalpena mokṣadātā viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti //
1.65.d:
षट्शताधिकसंख्यास्या दजपाया विभागशः ।
संकल्पेन मोक्षदाता विष्णुर्मे प्रीयतामिति ॥
1.65.m: and six hundred repetitions of the ajapā according to the divisions, / with the resolve: 'May Viṣṇu, the bestower of liberation, be pleased with me.'

1.65.s:
asyāḥ saṃkalpamātreṇa mahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate /
brahmaivāhaṃ na saṃsārī nityamukto na śokabhāk //
1.65.d:
अस्याः संकल्पमात्रेण महापापैः प्रमुच्यते ।
ब्रह्मैवाहं न संसारी नित्यमुक्तो न शोकभाक् ॥
1.65.m: By the mere resolve of this, one is released from great sins. / One should contemplate oneself: 'I am indeed Brahman, not a worldly transmigrant, eternally liberated, untouched by grief;

1.65.s:
sañcidānandarūpo 'hamātmānamiti bhāvayet /
tataḥ samācareddehakṛtyaṃ devārcanaṃ tathā //
1.65.d:
सञ्चिदानन्दरूपो ऽहमात्मानमिति भावयेत् ।
ततः समाचरेद्देहकृत्यं देवार्चनं तथा ॥
1.65.m: I am of the nature of being, consciousness, and bliss.' / Thereafter, one should perform the bodily duties and likewise the worship of the deity.

1.65.s:
taddhidhānaṃ pravakṣyāmi sadācārasya lakṣaṇam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde pañcaṣaṣṭimo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.65.d:
तद्धिधानं प्रवक्ष्यामि सदाचारस्य लक्षणम् ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे पञ्चषष्टिमो ऽध्यायः
1.65.m:
I shall proclaim that rule, the characteristic of good conduct.

Thus ends the sixty-fifth chapter in the third quarter of the Bṛhad-upākhyāna in the first part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.
